notes.title: Quality-of-Life Update: Focus-based Mute & Auto-Resize Window
notes.content: [p]This update adds two useful features to improve your playing experience:[/p][p][/p][h3]- Focus-based mute[/h3][p]The game will now automatically mute all audio when you alt-tab or the window loses focus.  [/p][p]When you return to the game, the sound will come back on its own.[/p][p][/p][h3]- Maximized window at launch[/h3][p]The game will now start in a maximized window by default, making it easier to jump right into gameplay.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for playing CountUp! [/p]
